rationale: Sigmoid for aux-loss must run in fp32; the buggy code feeds bf16 logits in. Root cause is dtype, not MoE topology (single-GPU reproduces, so parallel_dim=none per anti-example 6). Detected by hooking the op and checking input dtype == fp32 under precondition 'op == sigmoid_for_aux_loss', so pi_schema+pi_precond=true. Borderline P1 vs P4: chose P4 because op-level input dtype is not a default trace field, needs runtime hook.
